key_reasoning.reason: Statusline shows money figures; a wrong budget (personal vs project, shared pot vs per-member allowance, member override) is a correctness failure, and failures must never display a wrong figure. About 10 acceptance criteria (project budget, personal fallback, default project, shared pot, member override, per-member allowance, project switch, not-connected profile) each needed a distinct profile/project state. Shared pot and member override could not be created easily and required a purpose-built local backend. Delivered-effort scoring: verification dominated total time.

No new packages, but the work depended on environment prerequisites: a local backend emulating shared-pot and member-override projects, plus a separate user per scenario. Scored M for delivered verification-environment setup, not package count. Judgment call, applied per developer instruction.

Code lives in the Claude plugin statusline, but correctness depended on the CodeMie budget backend (External), profile/config resolution (Service), and the statusline output (UI), each exercised end to end under multiple actors. Scored M on verification breadth.
